title: Pals Rewards Points on Tailwise Pharmacy Fills
content:
Tailwise Pharmacy fills of classes marked as points-eligible earn Pals Rewards points on their merchandise amount after discount, at the member's earn rate. Fills of classes not marked as points-eligible earn nothing. Fees and shipping never earn points. A returned prescription diet fill reverses the points it earned.

## Earning basis restated

| Part of the amount billed on a fill | Earns points? |
|---|---|
| Merchandise subtotal less any discount, points-eligible class | Yes, at the member's earn rate |
| Merchandise of a class not points-eligible | No |
| Shipping fee | No |
| Compounding or adult-signature fee | No |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An Rx Compounded Medication fill billed as $48.00 merchandise, no discount, $9.95 shipping and a $12.50 compounding fee earns points on $48.00 only. An Rx Controlled Substance fill earns no points at all.

When an unopened prescription diet fill is returned, the points that fill earned are reversed.
